The '''Uvena system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], and the home system of the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanens]], containing the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Uvena Prime/Legends|Uvena Prime]] and [[Uvena III]].<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> It centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Uvena]].
